title: TodoSyncReport
description: Result of one todo_sync.py check run, written atomically to <state_dir>/todo-sync/report.json and read by the todo-watch mod. Derived data: never committed, rewritten by every check.

schema_version.description: Report contract version; bumped on a breaking change.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall time of the check run.

rules_run.description: Rule ids evaluated, in catalog order.

rules_skipped.description: Rule ids not evaluated, each with the reason (config key null, disabled, limited by --rules, input missing).

drift.description: Number of counted findings: every error, plus every warn when todo.rules.warn_counts is true.

by_rule.description: Counted findings per rule id; rules with none are absent. Values sum to drift.

counts.description: All findings per severity, counted or not.

gh_fetched_at.description: fetched_at of the issue cache the G rules read (ISO 8601); null when no cache was read.

findings.description: Every finding, errors first, then by rule id and file.

rule_id.description: Sync rule id (S research, P plans, T TODO catalog, G GitHub).

counted.description: Whether this finding is part of drift.

file.description: Repo-relative POSIX path the finding is about; null when it has none.

subject.description: Record the finding is about: an item id, entry id, plan item id or issue number.
